decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse sits close to the core yogurt range and its public recognition still justifies continuing, even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.
The semi-hard cheese wheel fits the established cheese business and costs little to keep, so the lack of visibility in 2020 and 2021 can still be treated as temporary rather than failure.
As a multi-variant line, the spicy cheese represents sizable sunk investment and assortment commitment that management will want to justify, despite no recent mentions.

The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the new cheese offer, and that visible commitment argues for persisting, although the earlier withdrawal of the flagship cheese raises the risk.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and least promoted item, has not been visible since launch, and the firm has already shown with Product B that it will prune cheese launches.
